heading.title: Of Acceptance and Payment for Honour and Reference in Case of Need

article.title: Acceptance not specifying for whose honour it is made.
article.content: Where the acceptance does not express for whose honour it is made it shall be deemed to be made for the honour of the drawer.
article.html:
110Acceptance not specifying for whose honour it is made.

Section 110 · Chapter XI · page 24 of the Act

Where the acceptance does not express for whose honour it is made it shall be deemed to be made for the honour of the drawer.
